requiredScenarios.title: Offline behavior
requiredScenarios.procedure: Disable all network transports, relaunch, use local data, and send a typed message with remote features unavailable.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: Local data remains usable, external calls fail clearly, and typed chat stays responsive.

requiredScenarios.title: Weak network behavior
requiredScenarios.procedure: Apply high latency, packet loss, and low bandwidth while starting and cancelling remote requests.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: Requests time out or cancel predictably without duplicate messages, frozen controls, or lost drafts.

requiredScenarios.title: Permission denial
requiredScenarios.procedure: Deny microphone, speech, photos, and file access when requested, then retry the related action.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: Denial is recoverable, no permission is requested before user action, and typed chat remains available.

requiredScenarios.title: Low-memory recovery
requiredScenarios.procedure: Create OS memory pressure while a populated chat is backgrounded, then return and continue the conversation.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: The process either resumes coherently or restores persisted state without corrupt data or duplicate sends.

requiredScenarios.title: Foreground and background recovery
requiredScenarios.procedure: Background and foreground during generation, STT, TTS, Live2D rendering, and an idle typed chat.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: Active media work stops safely, the UI resumes, and the persisted draft and chat remain coherent.

requiredScenarios.title: Performance baseline
requiredScenarios.procedure: Profile a release build for at least 30 minutes across chat scrolling, generation, feature panels, and idle time.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: Frame, memory, startup, and typed-chat latency stay within the declared thresholds without sustained growth.

requiredScenarios.title: Text chat with new features disabled
requiredScenarios.procedure: Disable memory extraction, RPG mode, Data Bank context, voice, Live2D, Tool Calling, and MCP, then create, send, swipe, edit, and reopen a text chat.
requiredScenarios.expectedResult: The text-only workflow matches the baseline and makes no new permission prompt or external request.
